name: Laboratory Bunsen Burner
semanticDescription: A standard NCERT Class 9-12 laboratory Bunsen burner with heavy cast-iron base, knurled air collar, gas needle valve, serrated hose barb, nickel-plated mixing chimney, and authentic multi-zone flame with longitudinal cutaway section detailing internal Venturi air entrainment and combustion flame thermometry.
simplifications: Flame is modeled as dual-layer emissive volumetric boundary cones with physically calibrated temperature color isotherms.

polished nickel-plated chimney tube, metallic 0.95, roughness 0.18
